\section{Methods}
\subsection{Encoding}
Because the raw input remains unaligned, the encoder constructs a shared representation.
\paragraph{Dynamic encoder}
Given the input sequence, the encoder extracts a dynamic representation.
\paragraph{Candidate generator}
The representation conditions generation of candidate states.
\paragraph{Candidate filter}
Remaining uncertainty determines which candidate states are retained.
\begin{equation}
z = f(x)
\end{equation}
where $x$ is the input and $z$ is the latent state.
The state enters the candidate generator.
Training updates the encoder parameters.
\subsection{Decoding}
Because the candidate state remains uncalibrated, the decoder maps it to the final output.
